sites_notice.other: Declared sites for this installation. A control session is not itself a site permission.

draft_creation_notice.other: Creation makes only a private draft and publishes nothing.

no_content.other: No content has been saved yet.

unknown_mutation_notice.other: If a mutation response was lost, inspect the same ID and do not submit the change again.

publication_intent_notice.other: This action does not make anything public.

publication_apply_notice.other: Publication intent only selects a revision. This action builds one coherent static generation and activates it only after freshness checks.

private_media_notice.other: Media references intentionally do not inline private originals.

appearance_locale_notice.other: These settings belong to the site and are independent from the administration interface language.

home_page_notice.other: In page mode, the ID must reference a saved page in this same site.

appearance_publication_notice.other: Saved appearance does not change the public site until a new coherent public generation is built and activated.

unknown_save_notice.other: If the save response was lost, inspect the same operation ID; do not automatically submit it again.

language.help.other: This choice changes only this browser’s administration language. Site content and terminal language are independent.

outcome_unknown.other: Outcome unknown. Do not submit again. Inspect operation {Operation}.

editor_drop_disabled.other: Drop is disabled. Upload files in File library and insert the stable Media ID here.

editor_invalid_link.other: Use an HTTPS URL or a site-relative path.

editor_invalid_media.other: Enter a valid Media asset ID.

return_and_retry.other: Return here and retry deliberately; your input stays in this page.

view_latest_new_tab.other: View the latest saved revision in another tab

conflict_keep_input.other: Keep your text here and compare changes before saving again.

save_source_notice.other: Saving creates a source revision. It does not publish, correct or withdraw public content.

draft_working.other: Saving or inspecting the selected site's content…

draft_saved.other: The source revision is saved. Public content has not changed.

draft_unknown.other: The save outcome is uncertain. Keep this page and operation ID. Inspect the result, or retry exactly the same submitted change under the same ID.

draft_inspection_missing.other: No result was found yet. This does not prove that the save did not commit. Keep the operation ID and inspect again or retry the same submitted change.

draft_inspection_failed.other: The result could not be inspected. Your pending change remains unresolved.

draft_result_mismatch.other: The response does not match this operation and selected site. Keep the pending operation for inspection; do not start a new save.

draft_conflict.other: The saved revision changed or this operation conflicts. Your input is preserved. View the latest saved revision and reconcile the changes before trying again.

draft_session_expired.other: Your session expired. Sign in in another tab, return here and retry. Your input and pending operation stay in this page.

draft_unavailable.other: The service is unavailable. Your input is preserved; retry when it is available.

draft_invalid.other: Check the title, content and submitted values. Your input is preserved.

draft_denied.other: You no longer have permission for this selected-site action. Your input is preserved.

draft_missing.other: The selected saved content is unavailable. Your input is preserved.

draft_limited.other: The service is busy. Your input is preserved; try again shortly.

draft_navigation_loss.other: Leaving this page will discard unsaved input or lose this page's pending-operation recovery. Copy the operation ID and any text you need before leaving. Leave this page?
